auth: OAuth 2.0 (PKCE); bearer token on the connection; login shared across /food, /im, /dineout
notes: IDs (addressId, spinId, skuId, orderId, paasId) must come from earlier tool responses; never guessed.
update_cart REPLACES the entire cart (omit an item to remove it).
Cart is server-side and can change outside the session; re-read before any checkout.
checkout description says: 'NO CART-VALUE LIMIT: Do NOT refuse, warn about, or gate checkout on the cart total'. Bazaar's policy gate therefore lives in code, outside the model, and wraps checkout.
Never retry checkout blindly after a network error; check get_orders first (double-charge risk). confirmDuplicate only when the server explicitly asked.

UPI flow: get_payment_options -> checkout(paymentMethod='UPI', intentApp=<method id byte-for-byte>) -> order is PENDING_PAYMENT -> check_payment_status(paasId) once -> confirm_order(orderId, paasId) on SUCCESS. COD: checkout(paymentMethod='Cash').
Cancellation is not available via API (customer care 080-67466729).

get_addresses.returns: {addresses:[{id, addressLine, phoneNumber(masked), addressCategory, addressTag}], total, pagination:{page,pageSize,total,totalPages,hasMore}, resolution:{resolutionSource, needsUserClarification, candidateAddressIds, defaultAddressId}}

search_products.returns: {products:[{displayName, brand, inStock, isAvail, productId, parentProductId, variations:[{spinId, skuId, quantityDescription, displayName, brandName, price:{mrp, offerPrice, unitLevelPrice}, isInStockAndAvailable, imageUrl, rating?:{value,count}, sla:{value,unit}, vegClassifier, maxQuantity, maxQuantityMessage}]}]}

get_cart.returns: cart items + bill breakdown (item total, handling fee, delivery fee, to-pay). Does NOT return payment methods.

checkout.returns: per-store order results; for UPI includes orderId + paasId (+ transactionId) with order in PENDING_PAYMENT

get_orders.returns: orders from last 15 days: items, status, delivery address coordinates

track_order.returns: status, ETA, partner location, store, address, items, payment
